instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app focusing purely on frontend execution. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts, and Shadcn for standard components.
Install `lucide-react` for icons and `framer-motion` for subtle scroll animations. Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Inter'.

HERO SECTION: A premium B2B fintech layout. Left column: 'New: Physical NACH Mandate' pill badge, large H1, description, and CTA. Right column: The 'hero_showroom' image with polished borders and subtle shadow.
FEATURES SECTION: 3 cards showing 'Large Credit Lines up to ₹15 cr', 'Weekly Repayment', 'Secure Physical Mandate'. Use minimalist Lucide icons (e.g. Banknote, Calendar, Shield).
5-STEP JOURNEY (CORE): Build a Sticky Scroll section. Left side: Steps 1 to 5 title navigation. Right side: Large mockup cards representing each step.
STEP 1 MOCK: Application form UI showing data fields (PAN, GSTIN) with a tooltip 'Auto-filled from GST data'.
STEP 2 MOCK: A drag-and-drop document upload box showing 'Aadhar' and 'PAN' files with green checkmarks.

STEP 3 MOCK (MOST IMPORTANT): Build a realistic Physical NACH mandate form mockup in HTML/CSS. Title: UMRN. Use an array of consecutive square `digit_box` classes for Account Number and IFSC fields. Include checkbox squares for Frequency (Monthly/Weekly). Add absolute positioned callouts: green (pre-filled by Razorpay), blue (signature here), orange (stamp area), red (Weekly frequency). Add a 'Documents Checklist' below it.
STEP 4 MOCK: A split-screen OCR scanner card. Left side: 'Scanned Document' with a CSS animated laser line. Right side: Status steps with 'Submitted to NPCI' marked complete.
STEP 5 MOCK: A dashboard view showing '₹8,00,00,000' approved limit using a semi-circle meter (or large typography) and a weekly schedule layout.
FAQ SECTION: Implement a simple Accordion for the 3 questions specified.
WEEKLY REPAYMENT CYCLE: Build a circular diagram with 4 nodes connected by arrows to represent the continuous credit cycle.
DOCUMENTS CHECKLIST: A neat two-column grid listing required onboarding documents, using green check icons.
FOOTER: Dark navy (#0F172A) background, primary and outline buttons, simple copyright/links.
Ensure ALL buttons, accordion toggles, and major inputs have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta"`).
Follow the High-Contrast Swiss Fintech Archetype: crisp borders, ample white space, deep navy text for authority, and Razorpay blue/green strictly for interactive/success states.
